systemArchitectures.name: Commercial Continuous Supercritical CO2 Astaxanthin Counter-Current Fractionation (scCO2-FAP) Skid
systemArchitectures.classification: Industrial High-Pressure Sanitary Bioactive Separation Skid (FDA 21 CFR § 73.35 / FDA 21 CFR § 117 FSMA cGMP / ASME BPVC Section VIII Div 1 & 2 / 3-A Sanitary Standards 60-01 / EHEDG Class I Aseptic)
systemArchitectures.technology: Multi-Stage Packed Column Supercritical CO2 Counter-Current Fractionator with Internal Reflux Temperature Gradient (40–65°C), Structured Sulzer Wire-Mesh Packing (>1,200 m²/m³), High-Pressure Dual Metering Pumps (180–350 bar), and Heated Automated Back-Pressure Regulators (BPR)
systemArchitectures.metallurgy: Monolithic Solid-Forged AISI 316L Stainless Steel Shell (Ra ≤ 0.38 µm electropolished), Hastelloy C-22 High-Pressure Head, Structured Titanium Gr. 2 Packing, and FDA Kalrez 6230 FFKM Sanitary Seals
systemArchitectures.safetyInterlocks: Dual Hydraulic Burst Discs (400 bar Burst Rating), Fast-Acting Emergency Depressurization Valve (EDV), Automated Column Temperature Runaway Interlock, and Ambient Optical CO2 Gas Leak Detection Grid (<5,000 ppm TWA)
systemArchitectures.description: Flagship industrial continuous high-pressure supercritical CO2 counter-current fractionation skid. Operates across 180–350 bar and 40–65°C over structured packing, achieving pure all-trans (3S,3'S) astaxanthin mono- and di-ester enrichment from microalgal oleoresin without toxic organic solvent residues or thermal degradation.

systemArchitectures.name: Aseptic Cleanroom Pharmaceutical Astaxanthin & Natural Carotenoid Fractionation Unit
systemArchitectures.classification: Aseptic Pharmaceutical Extraction Skid (ISO 14644-1 Class 5 / EU GMP Annex 1 / USP <467> / USP <2021> / FDA 21 CFR § 211)
systemArchitectures.technology: Sanitary High-Purity Twin-Column Supercritical CO2 Chromatography System with In-Line Ethanol Entrainer Injection (0.5–3.0% w/w) and Sub-Zero Separation Cyclone Separators
systemArchitectures.metallurgy: Solid Vacuum-Melted Hastelloy C-276 Column Core, Electropolished 316L Exterior (Ra ≤ 0.25 µm), and Platinum-Cured USP Class VI Silicone / Kalrez Sealing
systemArchitectures.safetyInterlocks: Ultra-Pure Nitrogen Blanketing Purge, In-Line Dual UV-Vis Diode Array Carotenoid Isomer Detector, and Automated ASME Overpressure Quench Relief System
systemArchitectures.description: Engineered for high-potency ophthalmic, cardiovascular, and clinical pharmaceutical applications. Delivers 99%+ pure all-trans (3S,3'S) astaxanthin esters with complete removal of lipid peroxides, heavy metals, and zero detectable organic solvent residues.

systemArchitectures.name: Industrial High-Throughput Microalgae Biorefinery Integrated scCO2-FAP System
systemArchitectures.classification: Commercial High-Throughput Biorefinery Skid (FSSC 22000 / USDA Organic / Non-GMO Project / ASME B31.3 / CE-PED)
systemArchitectures.technology: Large-Scale Continuous Packed Counter-Current Column with Integrated Closed-Loop Supercritical CO2 Compression & Vapor Recompression Liquefaction
systemArchitectures.metallurgy: ASME SA-336 F316L Clad Vessel Shell, Duplex 2205 High-Pressure Manifolds, and Ceramic Ball Check Valve Assemblies
systemArchitectures.safetyInterlocks: SCADA Continuous Density Monitoring, Triple Redundant Pressure Transmitters, and Ambient Acoustic Gas Rupture Alarm
systemArchitectures.description: Built for industrial-scale Haematococcus pluvialis microalgae processing plants. Continuously fractionates raw cracked-cell lipid paste into clarified neutral triglycerides (top light extract) and concentrated astaxanthin oleoresin (bottom product), recovering >95% CO2 in a closed thermodynamic loop.

systemArchitectures.name: Modular Analytical R&D Supercritical Fluid Counter-Current Fractionator
systemArchitectures.classification: Benchtop & Pilot Engineering Rig (ASME BPVC VIII / CE / UL 508A / GLP)
systemArchitectures.technology: High-Pressure Optical Sapphire Window Viewcell Column (up to 400 bar) with Automated Internal Temperature Profiling and Micro-Fraction Collector
systemArchitectures.metallurgy: Precision 316L Stainless Steel with Grade 9 Sapphire Windows and PTFE-Encapsulated O-Rings
systemArchitectures.safetyInterlocks: Touchscreen Emergency Stop, Mechanical Rupture Disc, and High-Temperature Thermal Cutoff
systemArchitectures.description: Used by food science universities and functional ingredient formulators to optimize phase equilibria, partition coefficients (K_astax), and retrograde solubility curves across novel natural carotenoid sources.

feedstocks.name: Haematococcus pluvialis Supercritical Crude Oleoresin (Flagship)
feedstocks.description: Premium microalgae oleoresin extracted from mechanical bead-mill disrupted encysted red aplanospores. Dominated by highly active all-trans (3S,3'S) astaxanthin mono-esters esterified with oleic, linoleic, and palmitic fatty acids.

feedstocks.name: Euphausia superba (Antarctic Krill) Phospholipid-Carotenoid Oleoresin
feedstocks.description: Marine lipid complex containing astaxanthin combined with high EPA/DHA omega-3 marine phospholipids. Fractionation isolates neutral storage fats into the light phase while retaining dense phospholipid-bound astaxanthin in the raffinate.

feedstocks.name: Xanthophyllomyces dendrorhous (Phaffia rhodozyma) Red Yeast Ferment
feedstocks.description: Fermentation-derived free astaxanthin. Unesterified free carotenoid has lower solubility in pure scCO2, requiring higher pressures or 2% ethanol co-solvent entrainer to achieve sharp separation from neutral fungal sterols.

feedstocks.name: Conventional Crude Solvent Extract Algal Paste (High Contaminant Hazard)
feedstocks.description: Hazardous reference: thermally abused chemical solvent extraction. Contains residual hexane (>250 ppm, violating USP <467>), degraded astacene artifacts, oxidized lipid peroxides, and massive cis-isomerization with severely impaired biological activity.

columnPackingDesigns.name: Sulzer EX Structured Stainless Steel Wire-Gauze Packing
columnPackingDesigns.description: Ultra-high-efficiency structured packing for supercritical extraction columns. Capillary spreading over woven wire mesh creates an ultra-thin continuous liquid falling film, maximizing interfacial mass transfer K_L a (>4.5 s^-1) with near-zero hydraulic pressure drop.

columnPackingDesigns.name: Sulzer DX High-Capacity Corrugated Sheet Metal Packing
columnPackingDesigns.description: High-capacity structured packing designed for commercial biorefinery scale. Resists fouling from viscous algal waxes and allows high downward liquid throughput without column flooding or entrainment.

columnPackingDesigns.name: Random Ceramic Mini-Raschig Rings (Legacy Benchmark)
columnPackingDesigns.description: Legacy random packing with high HETP and severe channeling risks under supercritical fluids. Requires columns more than 3x taller to reach comparable theoretical stages.

engineeringFormulas.name: Chrastil Density-Dependent Solubility Model
engineeringFormulas.description: Governs the equilibrium solubility of high-molecular-weight carotenoids in supercritical carbon dioxide as a direct exponential function of fluid density ρ_CO2 and absolute temperature T (K).

engineeringFormulas.name: Counter-Current Separation Factor (Selectivity)
engineeringFormulas.description: Quantifies thermodynamic partition selectivity between the ascending supercritical gas phase and descending falling-film liquid phase across column packing stages.

engineeringFormulas.name: Height Equivalent to a Theoretical Plate (Van Deemter)
engineeringFormulas.formula: HETP = A + B / u_gas + C * u_gas
engineeringFormulas.description: Determines the physical column height needed for single equilibrium separation stage under structured capillary wire gauze packing.

engineeringFormulas.name: Non-Thermal Carotenoid Isomerization Rate Constant
engineeringFormulas.description: Shows that operating under low-temperature anaerobic scCO2 (<50°C) reduces thermal cis-isomerization by >98% compared to traditional steam or vacuum deodorization.

engineeringFormulas.name: ASME BPVC Section VIII Pressure Vessel Safety Factor
engineeringFormulas.description: Validates that forged 316L/Hastelloy column walls withstand operating pressures up to 350 bar with proof-testing margin exceeding ASME safety codes.

regulatoryStandards.title: Astaxanthin from Haematococcus pluvialis Color Additive Exempt from Certification
regulatoryStandards.scope: Permits natural astaxanthin in foods and dietary supplements; mandates purity >96%, lead <5 ppm, arsenic <2 ppm, mercury <1 ppm.

regulatoryStandards.title: Residual Solvents in Dietary Supplements and Pharmaceuticals
regulatoryStandards.scope: Zero hazardous chemical solvent residues (0.0 ppm for carbon dioxide process vs. 290 ppm legal threshold for hexane).

regulatoryStandards.title: Rules for Construction of Pressure Vessels (Divisions 1 & 2)
regulatoryStandards.scope: Pressure vessel design rating up to 400 bar, full radiographic weld inspection, and dual safety relief valves.

regulatoryStandards.title: Sanitary Standards for Vessels for Processing and Storage of Food Products
regulatoryStandards.scope: Electropolished product-contact surfaces (Ra ≤ 0.38 µm), sanitary Tri-Clamp connections, and self-draining columns.

regulatoryStandards.title: Current Good Manufacturing Practice (cGMP) & Hazard Analysis (FSMA)
regulatoryStandards.scope: Environmental monitoring, clean-in-place (CIP) validation, and chemical/biological contaminant prevention.

operationalModes.name: High-Purity All-Trans Astaxanthin Ester Mode
operationalModes.primaryBenefit: Maximum clinical antioxidant potency with zero thermal or oxidative degradation.

operationalModes.name: Neutral Triglyceride & FFA Stripping Mode
operationalModes.primaryBenefit: Extracts neutral storage fats overhead while retaining dense carotenoids in bottom raffinate.

operationalModes.name: Pharma-Grade Carotenoid Enrichment Mode
operationalModes.primaryBenefit: Requires 1.5% ethanol entrainer to selectively solubilize free unesterified astaxanthin.
